content: Yesu Mʋa Mʋ Apio Yinhɛ́
Mʋ́ ɔma a, Yesu létsiá kí Galilea ɔmátɔ́. Omekleá ɔbɔ́yɔ Yudea ɔmátɔ́, tsúfɛ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bʋdɛ mʋ tɛ́ɛ abʋmɔ mʋ.
Támɛ Yudafɔ Kantankpatɔtsiá Nkegyí lafʋn.
Mʋ́ sʋ mʋ apio yinhɛ́ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Natɩ yɔ Yudea nkɛ ámʋ ogyíkpá, mɛ́nɩ fʋ́ abúopʋ amʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ ámʋ ɛ́ bówun ofúla ánɩ́ fʋdɛbwɛ.
Ɔhá ánɩ́ odekléá ahá bʋbɩ́ɩ mʋ gyumagyihɛ tamaŋáín ɩwɩ. Ɩ́nɩá fʋ́dɛ ntobíá igyi alɩ bwɛ á, wuna lɛ mʋ́ suna, ɔyɩ́ fɛ́ɛ́ abʋwun.”
(Mʋ apíó ámʋ kʋ́ráá bʋmɔhɔ mʋ gyi. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛbláa mʋ alɩ nɩ́.)
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Brɛ́á nɔ́yɔ ɩnʋ mɔkʋ́nyá fʋn. Mlɩ mʋ́ mlɛ́talɩ́ yɔ́ ɩnʋ brégyíbrɛ́.
Ɔyɩ́tɔ́fɔ bʋmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ lú mlɩ, támɛ mɩ́ mʋ́ bʋdɛ mɩ́ lu, tsúfɛ́ ndɛ amʋ́ ɩlá lɛ.
Mlɩyɔ nkɛ ámʋtɔ. Mɩ́ mʋ́ mmɔkʋ́nyá yɔ́, tsúfɛ́ mɩ́ brɛ́ mɔkʋ́fʋn.”
Yesu lɛ́blɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ tá á, olesi tsiá Galilea ɔmátɔ́.
Yesu Kantankpatɔtsiá Nkɛ Ámʋ Ogyíkpá Yɔ
Támɛ brɛ́á Yesu apíó ámʋ bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ nkɛ ámʋ ogyíkpá a, mʋ ɛ́ oleŋaín ɩwɩ yɔ́ ɩnʋ.
Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bodunká mʋ nkɛ ámʋ ogyíkpá, bʋdɛ ahá fɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Oyin ámʋ mɛ?”
Ɔdɔm amʋ bɛblɩ́ asʋ́n tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ nklobítɔ tsú Yesu ɩwɩ. Akʋ bɛɛ, “Ɔha wankláán ogyi.” Akʋ ɛ́ bɛɛ, “Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ, ɔdɛ ahá mlɛ́.”
Támɛ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔhaa mɛ́talɩ́ blɩ́ mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n kʋ́klʋ́ ahá abʋnu, tsúfɛ́ bʋdɛ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ ifú nya.
Brɛ́á bowie nkɛ ámʋ nsɩnɛ́ á, Yesu lɔ́dʋ wíé Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ yéfi atɔ́ suná asɩ.
Mʋ atosunáhɛ́ lobwie Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ ɔnɔ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ mɔ́kʋ́kásɩ́ ɔwʋlʋ́ yɔ́ nkpá. Nkálɩ ɩlɔbwɛ asa ɔlɛbɩ ɔwʋlʋ́ alɩ?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Megyí mɩ́ wá atosunáhɛ́ anfɩ itsú. Itsú Bulu wá. Mʋlɔ́wa mɩ́ sɩ́sɩ́.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ dékléá ɔbɔ́bwɛ Bulu apɛ́ á, obówun nɩ́ atosunáhɛ́ anfɩ itsú mɩ́ wá ntɛ́ɛ Bulu wá.
Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔdɛ mʋ onutó asʋ́n blɩ́ dɛ́ mʋ numnyam dunká. Támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ todúnká numnyam há ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔlɔwa mʋ sɩ́sɩ́ á, ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ ɔhá ámʋ gyí. Ɔtamawá afunu.
Yɛ́ɛ Mose lɔ́pʋ mbla ámʋ ba mlɩ a? Támɛ mlɩtɔ ɔkʋkʋ mɛ́dɛ́ mʋ́sʋ́ gyi. Ntogyi sʋ mlɩdékléá mlɔ́mɔ mɩ́?”
Ɩnʋ ɔdɔm amʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ fʋtɔ! Ma dékléá ɔbɔ́mɔ fʋ́?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ofúla kʋlɛ pɛ́ nɔbwɛ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́, mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔnɔ́ lobwie mlɩ.
Mose lɔ́wa mbla há mlɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, mlɩtɩ́ɩn keté. (Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́ ánɩ́ megyí Mose lɔ́tsɔ keté tɩ́n, mlɩ anáin léfi mʋ́ asɩ.) Yɛ́ɛ mʋ́ sʋ́ mlɩtɛtɩn ahá keté ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ nɩ́ a?
Nɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ keté tɩ́ɩn ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́, mɛ́nɩ mlɩmɔ́ɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ Mose mbla ámʋsʋ á, ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩlanyá ɔblɔ́ mɩ́sʋ́ mlɩaa, natsá nyankpʋsa kɛ́ɩ́n ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́?
Mlɩyɔ asʋ́ntɔ́ wankláán, asa amlɩha ɩpɔ́n. Mlɩpʋ ɔnɔkwalɩ gyi asʋ́n.”
Yesu Ɩwɩ Nwɛ́ɛngyí
Yerusalemfɔ akʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɩwɩ bɛɛ, “Megyí oyin ánfɩ Yudafɔ ahandɛ bʋdedunká abʋmɔ nɩ́?
Megyí mʋ lɩ́ɩ́ ahátɔ ɔdɛtɔɩ́, amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋkʋ mɛ́kpla mʋ a? Ntɛ́ɛ ɩlawánkɩ́ amʋ́ ánɩ́ mʋgyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) nɩ?
Oyin ánfɩ mʋ́ a, anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ anɩyin ɔtɩ́nɛ́á otsú, támɛ nɩ́ Kristo ámʋ ɔbá á, ɔhaa mɛ́ɛbɩ ɔtɩ́nɛ́á otsú.”

Brɛ́á Yesu bʋ mʋ́sʋ́ ɔdɛ atɔ́ ámʋ suná Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ á, olotsu ɔnɔ́ fʋ́á blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyin mɩ, mlɩyin ɔtɩ́nɛ́á notsú, támɛ megyí mɩ́ onutó túmisʋ nɛba. Ɔnɔkwalɩpʋ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔwa mɩ́ sɩ́sɩ́ ámʋ gyí. Mlɩméyín mʋ.
Támɛ mɩ́ mʋ́ nyin mʋ, tsúfɛ́ mʋlɔ́wa mɩ́ sɩ́sɩ́. Mʋ wá notsu ba.”
Ɩnʋ bekle abʋkɩta mʋ, támɛ bʋmɔpʋ ɩbɩ da mʋ, tsúfɛ́ mʋ brɛ́ mɔkʋ́fʋn.
Támɛ amʋ́tɔ́ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɔhɔ mʋ gyi. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ “Nɩ́ Kristo amʋ ɔbá á, ɔbɛ́talɩ́ bwɛ́ osúna dʋn mʋ́ ánfɩ oyin ánfɩ dɛ́bwɛ?”
Bɔwa Bɛɛ Bʋkɩ́ta Yesu
Brɛ́á Farisifɔ ámʋ bonu ánɩ́ ɔdɔm amʋ bʋdɛ Yesu ɩwɩ asʋ́n blɩ́ nklobítɔ á, amʋ́a Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ bɔwa Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa agyópʋ bɛɛ bʋkɩ́ta Yesu.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩlasí nkɛ kpalobí pɛ́ nétsiá mlɩ wá. Mʋ́ ɔma a, néyinkí yɔ́ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔwa mɩ́ sɩ́sɩ́ ámʋ wá.
Mlódunká mɩ́, támɛ mlɩmóowun mɩ. Mlɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ ba ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mbʋ ɛ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.”

Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Nkʋ́nʋ́ oyin ánfɩ obótu ɔkpa yɔ́, sʋ abódunká mʋ anɩmóowun mʋ? Ntɛ́ɛ odekléá ɔbɔ́yɔ Griikifɔ awúlu amʋ́ʋ́ anɩ pɩ badásáɩ́n yɔ́ mʋ́sʋ́ ámʋsʋ, ntɛ́ɛ obóyósuná Griikifɔ ámʋ atɔ́?
Asʋ́n ánfɩ ɔdɛblɩ́ ɛ́ asɩ mɛ́? Ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mlódunká mɩ́, támɛ mlɩmóowun mɩ. Mlɩmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ ba ɔtɩ́nɛ́á mbʋ ɛ́.’ ”
Nkpa Ntsu
Nkɛ ámʋ ɛkɛ tráhɛá ígyi ɛkɛ títriu á, Yesu lɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ kplʋn blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ ɔmɛwʋ́lɩ dɛ ɔkʋ á, ɔbá mɩ́ wá obonu ntsu.
Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ mɩ gyi a, ‘Nkpa ntsu bɔ́wɩ dalɩ mʋtɔ.’ Alɩ́ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ nɩ́.”
(Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́ha ahá ánɩ́ bɔ́hɔ mʋ gyi amʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ɔdɛblɩ́. Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ mɔ́kʋ́nyá ba, tsúfɛ́ Bulu mɔ́kʋ́nyá wá Yesu numnyam.)
Ahá Ámʋtɔ Leye
Brɛ́á ɔdɔm amʋ bonu Yesu asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ anfɩ á, amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Lɛ́lɛ́, Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ́ʋ́ anɩdɛ́ mʋ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ amʋ nɩ.”
Akʋ ɛ́ bɛɛ, “Kristo amʋ nɩ!” Támɛ amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ ɛ́ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Yɛ́ɛ megyí Galilea ɔmátɔ́ Kristo amʋ obótsu o.
Bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, Owíe Dawid abusuantɔ Kristo amʋ ɔbɛ́dalɩ tsu. Bɔ́kwɩɩ́ mʋ Betlehem, Dawid wúlutɔ.”
Ɩna Yesu ɩwɩ asʋ́n ánfɩ sʋ ɩkʋlɛbwɛ metsiá amʋ́tɔ́.
Amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bekle abʋkɩta Yesu, támɛ ɔhaa mɔ́pʋ ɩbɩ da mʋ.
Yesu Máhogyi
Ɔma-ɔma a, Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa agyópʋ amʋ́ʋ́ bɔwa sumbí ámʋ bɛsankí ba Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Farisifɔ ámʋ wá. Bɛfɩtɛ́ agyópʋ amʋ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ mlɩmɛ́kɩtá mʋ ba?”
Bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Ɔhaa mɔ́kʋ́tɔ́ɩ́ fɛ́ oyin ánfɩ kɩ!”
Farisifɔ ámʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ bɛɛ, “Mʋ́ sʋ oyin ámʋ lamlɛ́ mlɩ ɛ́.
Mlɩlawun ɔhandɛ ntɛ́ɛ Farisiyin ɔkʋ lahɔ mʋ gyi kɩ?
Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Ɔdɔm anfɩ bʋmeyín Mose mbla ámʋ ɩwɩ tɔtɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ Bulu ɔlwɩ́ɩ amʋ́.”
Ɩnʋ Farisifɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛ, ogyi Nikodemo amʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔyɔ Yesu wá onyé ámʋ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Anɩ mbla lɛha ɔkpa ánɩ́ abɛ́ha ɔkʋ ɩpɔ́n asa abɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔnɔ́tɔ́ asʋ́n nú?”
Bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Galileayin fʋ́ ɛ́ fʋ́gyi? Kɩ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ wankláán. Fówun ánɩ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ ɔkʋkʋʋkʋ móotsu Galilea ɔmátɔ́.”
[Ɩnʋ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ wóyítɔ́.
